result.description:
Location: Woolner NT, with work across the Northern Territory
Employment Type: Full-time
Hours: 38 hours per week
Salary: AUD $69,000 to $89,000 per annum plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience

About Us
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the Employer
The business (ABN 53 603 812 004) is a Darwin-based specialist HVAC hygiene company providing cleaning, inspection and maintenance services for commercial and industrial air conditioning systems, ductwork, commercial kitchen exhaust systems, cool rooms and mould-affected environments throughout the Northern Territory. Our clients include commercial, industrial, Defence and government organisations requiring specialist indoor air quality and HVAC hygiene services.  

We are looking for a reliable HVAC Cleaning Technician (High Access) to join our team.

About the Role
The HVAC Cleaning Technician (High Access) will carry out specialist cleaning, maintenance and inspection work on HVAC systems located in commercial, industrial and high-access environments. The role routinely involves safely accessing rooftop plant, elevated work areas and other difficult-to-reach locations using approved ladders, elevated work platforms and other approved height access equipment. 

The successful applicant will:
- Safely access rooftop plant, elevated mechanical services, ceiling spaces and other difficult-to-reach work areas using ladders, fall-arrest systems, elevated work platforms (EWPs), scissor lifts and other approved height access equipment to perform specialist HVAC cleaning, inspection and maintenance activities.
- Carry out specialised cleaning and hygiene services for commercial and industrial HVAC systems, ductwork and ventilation systems.
- Clean air handling units (AHUs), plant rooms, supply and return air ducts, evaporator coils, condenser units, filters and associated HVAC equipment.
- Perform commercial kitchen exhaust system cleaning, including hoods, ductwork, fans and associated ventilation equipment.
- Clean cool rooms, ventilation equipment and other specialist environments to maintain hygiene and operational standards.
- Assist with mould remediation and microbial cleaning projects in accordance with company procedures.
- Conduct pre-start inspections of elevated work areas, identify potential hazards and implement appropriate safety controls before commencing work. 
- Operate specialist cleaning equipment, including pressure cleaning equipment, HEPA vacuum systems and other industry-specific cleaning tools.
- Take photographs, complete digital job records, inspection reports and service documentation for completed works.
- Maintain company vehicles, tools, equipment and personal protective equipment in a safe and serviceable condition.
- Work professionally with clients, contractors and other team members while maintaining the company's high standards of workmanship and customer service.

Applicants should have:
- Experience in commercial HVAC cleaning, industrial cleaning, building maintenance, duct cleaning, ventilation system cleaning, or a similar hands-on trade or technical environment.
- Demonstrated ability and confidence to safely work at heights in commercial and industrial environments while complying with WHS requirements. 
- Experience using ladders, elevated work platforms (EWP), scissor lifts or other approved height access equipment will be highly regarded.
- Ability to operate pressure cleaning equipment, HEPA vacuum systems and other specialist cleaning equipment.
- Good physical fitness and the ability to perform manual work in commercial and industrial environments.
- Ability to read and follow work instructions, safe work procedures and site-specific requirements.
- Basic computer or mobile device skills to complete digital job records, inspection reports and photographic documentation.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a small team.
- A strong work ethic, attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality workmanship and customer service.
- Comfortable working on rooftops, elevated mechanical plant and other high-access locations as part of normal day-to-day duties. 

Applicants should have:
- Current Working at Heights certificate, or willingness to obtain prior to commencement
- Current driver licence.
- Current NT White Card or equivalent
- Elevated Work Platform licence or demonstrated experience operating EWP will be highly regarded
- Confined Space or First Aid training, or other relevant safety training preferred.

How to Apply
We are looking for motivated and reliable people who enjoy practical work and take pride in delivering high-quality HVAC hygiene, cleaning and maintenance services.  

To apply, please submit:
- A current resume outlining your relevant work experience and the contact details of two referees.
- A cover letter (maximum 600 words) addressing the following:
- Why you are applying for this position.
- An example of when you demonstrated excellent customer service, initiative or teamwork (using the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action and Result).
- How your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of this role.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a practical, professional team delivering specialist HVAC hygiene, duct cleaning, kitchen exhaust cleaning, mould remediation and commercial cleaning services across the Northern Territory, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Walk-in or telephone enquiries regarding this vacancy will not be accepted.

Applications close: 1 August 2026

result.description:
Randstad is proud to partner with Queensland Rail (QR) on a major recruitment drive to source engineering professionals. As part of this major recruitment drive, we are looking to identify an experienced Principal Telecommunications Network Engineer - ETCS for the ETCS Sequence Alliance (Embedded) division.  
  QR has a current project pipeline of over A$15 billion, and this is expected to grow exponentially in the build-up to the 2032 Brisbane Olympic and Paralympic Games.. As a result of this significant investment, the need to secure in-house technical and engineering resources is paramount to support their critical technology rollouts. This includes ensuring that European Train Control Systems (ETCS) telecommunications networks are technically robust and compliant across the network.  
  What You'll Do  
  The Principal Telecommunications Network Engineer - ETCS will provide specialist engineering services and technical leadership to project-based teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that ETCS telecommunications networks are technically robust, commercially optimized, and seamlessly integrated.  
 
  Drive Engineering Excellence  : Monitor and influence ETCS Cross River Rail (CRR) telecommunications data system projects, ensuring peak performance levels are achieved at competitive costs. You will ensure that integration into the QR data network never compromises reliability, availability, or maintainability.  
  Coach & Inspire:   Lead the facilitation of technical training and competency development for telecommunications office and field staff, ensuring a powerful capability uplift and compliance across teams.  
  Innovate & Optimize  : Ensure technical standards and procedures are meticulously documented and applied in accordance with Queensland Rail Quality Assurance and Improvement Principles.  
  Thought Leader  : Provide strategic technical leadership and advice to business groups, technical staff, and external stakeholders, ensuring complex network solutions align perfectly with QR's operational requirements.  
   Uphold Integrity : Champion strict compliance with professional engineering practices, Queensland Rail standards, and all corporate legal and safety obligations.  
 
  What We Are Looking For  
  We are looking for a strong implementor in the network engineering space who brings a deep understanding of data communications, commercial acumen, and high-level stakeholder management skills.  
 
  Qualifications  : A Bachelor of Engineering (Electrical & Electronic)   AND   ideally   current Registered Professional Engineer Queensland (RPEQ) status   or   have the necessary qualifications and experience to attain it. IE: have CEng or Professional Engineer status with Engineers Australia.  
  Network Telecoms Experience:   Extensive knowledge of LAN/WAN data communications, and physical network security applicable to a railway network. You must bring high-level skills in the design, system configuration, construction, auditing, commissioning, integration, and technical support of telecommunications network systems. Candidates would ideally come from a client or contractor background and have strong implementation experience.  
  Analytical & Technical Depth:   Extensive knowledge of telecommunications performance and integration principles, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to keep ETCS CRR projects operationally effective.  
  Commercial Acumen:   A proven track record of delivering business-focused technical and professional network solutions that bring tangible commercial value to the business.  
  Soft Skills & Influence  : High levels of interpersonal, influencing, and negotiation skills.  
 
  Queensland Rail is a progressive organisation that promotes a flexible working environment to allow for a healthy work-life balance. It actively prioritizes the development of its people in a supportive, diverse, and inclusive work culture.  
  QR offers the following benefits:  
 
  Competitive remuneration packages  
  Comprehensive relocation assistance (if applicable)  
  A long-term consistent pipeline of work, offering job security and stellar opportunities for technical and professional development  
 
  Why choose Queensland to live and work?  
  More people from within Australia are migrating to Queensland than to any other state! It's hard not to see why, with a fantastic climate, affordable housing, stunning beaches, national parks, and one of the great wonders of the world - The Great Barrier Reef, Queensland has it all.  
  How to apply  
  If you want to grasp this life changing opportunity then please click apply.   For more information visit our landing page www.randstad.com.au/rail-australia/  

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
Your new company  
 You will be joining one of Australia's largest underground mining operations and play a critical role in supporting and improving the operational technology systems that keep the site running safely, reliably and efficiently. 
   
  Your new role  
 We are seeking an experienced Process Control Engineer with strong expertise in Rockwell PLCs, AVEVA Plant SCADA (Citect) and Cicode development to support a range of operational and improvement initiatives across processing and mining operations. 
  Key responsibilities include:  
 
  Supporting and maintaining Rockwell ControlLogix and CompactLogix PLC systems.  
  Developing, supporting and enhancing AVEVA Plant SCADA (Citect) applications.  
  Developing and troubleshooting custom Cicode applications.  
  Investigating and resolving complex PLC, SCADA, instrumentation and communication issues.  
  Supporting commissioning, shutdowns and operational readiness activities.  
  Driving process optimisation, reliability improvements and continuous improvement initiatives.  
  Supporting control system upgrades, modifications and capital projects.  
  Managing change control, documentation and engineering governance requirements.  
 
   
  What you'll need to succeed  
 
  Degree qualification in Electrical, Automation, Control Systems or Mechatronics Engineering.  
  5+ years' experience in Process Control, Automation or Control Systems Engineering.  
  Advanced experience with Rockwell ControlLogix and CompactLogix platforms.  
  Advanced experience with AVEVA Plant SCADA (Citect).  
  Demonstrated experience developing and supporting Cicode applications.  
  Strong PLC programming, commissioning and fault-finding skills.  
  Experience within mining, minerals processing, heavy industrial or manufacturing environments.  
  Strong understanding of industrial communications protocols including Ethernet/IP, Modbus and OPC.  
 
   
  What you'll get in return  
 
  8-12 month contract opportunity.  
  4 days on, 3 days off FIFO roster - 12hr days.  
  Flights provided from Brisbane or Townsville.  
  Opportunity to work on a large-scale mining and processing operation.  
  Exposure to operational technology, automation and continuous improvement projects.  
 
   
  What you need to do now  
 If this sounds like the role for you, apply now or email me on Tillyah.Toamau@hays.com.au for a confidential discussion.  Please  click here  to apply.
